evals.prompt: I launched the self-hosted Buzz Docker Compose stack, but the desktop app gets a 404 when it connects through localhost.
evals.expected_output: A layer-by-layer diagnosis that checks the configured relay URL and addresses the documented localhost versus 127.0.0.1 loopback mismatch before changing unrelated services.
assertions: The response checks the relay URL before recommending a rebuild.
The response distinguishes localhost from 127.0.0.1 where relevant.
The response verifies the fix from a real client connection.

evals.prompt: My self-hosted relay is closed. Add a new agent safely and verify it can join the intended channel.
evals.expected_output: A security-conscious membership workflow that separates relay admission, channel membership, and successful end-to-end messaging.
assertions: The response does not request private keys in chat.
The response distinguishes relay admission from channel membership.
The response requires an actual message exchange for verification.

evals.prompt: My unrelated Docker Compose application has a failing Postgres health check. Help me fix Docker.
evals.expected_output: A boundary response that recognizes this is not a self-hosted Buzz relay task and avoids applying Buzz-specific instructions.
assertions: The response does not invoke Buzz relay setup steps.
The response clearly identifies the request as general Docker troubleshooting.
